profile_text.body:
RICHTECH ROBOTICS INC. is recorded as a for-profit public company headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, with the ticker RR and CIK 0001963685. The website associated with the record is rolls-royce.com, and the text harvested from that site describes Rolls-Royce rather than a robotics business. In that text the company describes itself as pioneering technologies that deliver clean, safe and competitive solutions for power needs, and as developing complex power and propulsion solutions for safety-critical applications in the air, at sea and on land, with more than 100 years of innovation behind it.

The same site text reports several developments: Rolls-Royce completing a $1 Billion investment in Indiana, a stated intent by Reliance Industries and Rolls-Royce to partner on India's indigenous combat engine for the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme, cooperation between Rolls-Royce, the United Kingdom National Nuclear Laboratory and the Japan Atomic Energy Agency on advanced nuclear technologies, and Rolls-Royce SMR holding multiple contractual commitments to deliver SMR units in Europe after signing a contract with CEZ Group.

The held record lists no products, no MCP servers and no litigation cases, and its law exposure entry covers Nevada with a count of zero. No AI products or AI positioning are attributed to the company in the available material, and the site content and the company name in the record do not match.
